title: Index of the maximum
prompt: Implement `static int MaxIndex(int[] values)` — the **index** of the largest element. Ties resolve to the *first* occurrence. Null or empty returns -1.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: The tie rule is the discriminator: the first occurrence wins.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: -1 for no data (not 0 — 0 would be a lie for arrays whose max sits at index 0); negatives and ties together.
